fields.title: actions/setup-dotnet
fields.licence: MIT AND Apache-2.0 AND BlueOak-1.0.0 AND ISC AND 0BSD

sections.What we use it for:
Every step passes `global-json-file: global.json`, so it installs the SDK that file pins. The `round-trip` and `import-round-trip` jobs in `kac.yml` run it on `windows-latest` as well as `ubuntu-latest`.

The action takes no token. It runs in the `publish` jobs of `publish-corpus.yml`, `publish-plugin.yml` and `publish-tool.yml`, so its code runs in a job with a write permission.

Every step pins the action to the commit behind `v6.0.0`, and Dependabot moves the pin. `versions` approves the major the pin sits in.
sections.Licence and obligations:
The repository and its `package.json` declare MIT. The action runs bundled code under `dist/`, and the `.licenses/` folder at the pinned commit records each npm dependency in it. Most are MIT. The others are these:

| Licence       | Packages                                                                         |
|---------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Apache-2.0    | `@protobuf-ts/runtime`, `@protobuf-ts/runtime-rpc`, `before-after-hook`          |
| BlueOak-1.0.0 | one version of `minimatch`                                                       |
| ISC           | the other version of `minimatch`, `semver`, `universal-user-agent`               |
| 0BSD          | `tslib`                                                                          |

The five entries marked `other` are two versions of `@actions/http-client`, `balanced-match`, `brace-expansion` and `concat-map`. Each licence file is the MIT text.

The runner fetches the action for each job, and nothing here redistributes it, so nothing follows for anything this repository publishes.
sections.Where it is used:
* [svc-corpus-feed](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/8ea1b5a5f9f175b28a13b15fe1ccd03249bf34af/examples/dog-fooding/services/corpus-feed.md) is packed with the SDK it installs.
* [svc-kac](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/8ea1b5a5f9f175b28a13b15fe1ccd03249bf34af/examples/dog-fooding/services/kac.md) is built, tested and packed with it.
* [svc-marketplace](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/8ea1b5a5f9f175b28a13b15fe1ccd03249bf34af/examples/dog-fooding/services/marketplace.md) is bundled with it.
